title: token-level observability: add per-token cost & latency metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Ethan Chen
description:
Motivation: Teams need token-level attribution to understand per-request economics and tail-latency drivers. This PR adds token-level metrics (counts, per-token latency, and estimated cost) emitted from the serving runtime, a set of Redwood Console dashboards that slice cost/latency by model, route, customer, and token position, and tuned alerting rules that reduce noise while surfacing regressions.

Changes in this PR: emits new Prometheus metrics with stable names (redwood_tokens_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_cents_total), enriches traces with token_count and token_cost tags, adds console dashboards (token-cost-overview, token-latency-tail), updates prometheus scrape and recording rules, and tunes existing alerts to use p99/p95 token-latency histograms instead of request-level aggregates. Also includes an end-to-end integration test and docs for how teams can interpret token-level charts and link them back to traces.

Safety: metrics use exponential histogram buckets to avoid cardinality explosions; token text is NOT logged or exposed in metrics/traces (we only emit numeric token position and counts). Alert thresholds were calibrated on production-like traffic (perf-canary) and included a short monitoring window to avoid transient flaps.

Notes: follow-up items (separate PRs) include UI drill-down for example prompts, additional aggregation by quantization profile, and storage backfill to populate historical dashboards for the last 30 days.
commits: Add token-level metrics to runtime emitter
Expose token latency histogram and token cost counters
Integration test for token metrics emission
review_comments: Aisha Khan: Can you confirm we are not including raw token text anywhere? Please document privacy guarantees.
Ethan Chen: Confirmed. We only emit numeric token position/cost/latency. Added explicit note in docs and code comment. See runtime/telemetry/token_metrics.rs line 78.
Marco Alvarez: The histogram buckets look reasonable but I'd like to see an extra bucket at 5s to capture extreme tails. Updated recording_rules.yml accordingly.
Priya Patel: Alert noise is the biggest concern. Did you test the tuned thresholds on perf-canary?
Ethan Chen: Yes — ran perf-canary for 48h with thresholds at p99=1.8s and p95=0.9s, saw <3% false positives. Added a short mute window and escalation policy in alerts.yml.
Aisha Khan: Approved after doc clarifications.
release_notes: Added token-level observability: per-token latency and cost metrics, new dashboards in Redwood Console, and tuned alerts to surface token-level regressions. (Docs: docs/observability/token-metrics.md)
